description_en: Queries the list of all products
description_zh: 调用该接口查看所有产品列表
name: QueryProductList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of products to display on each page. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的产品数量，最大值是200
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The ResourceGroupId request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of product to query. Valid values:

iothub_senior: products that use Thing Specification Language models.

iothub: products that do not use Thing Specification Language models.

If you do not specify this parameter, all products are returned
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查看的产品类型，取值：

iothub_senior：使用物模型版产品。

iothub：不使用物模型版产品。

如果不传入该参数，则返回所有产品的列表
parameters.name: aliyun_commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The product information returned if the call was successful. For more information, see the following parameters
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的产品信息。具体信息请参见以下参数

ProductInfo.description_en:
The list of product information.

The returned products are sorted in reverse chronological order by creation time
ProductInfo.description_zh:
产品信息列表。

返回的产品信息按照产品创建时间倒序排列

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication method used by devices under the product to connect to IoT Platform. Valid values:

secret: device secret-based authentication.

id2: ID²-based authentication.

x509: X.509 certificate-based device verification
AuthType.description_zh:
产品下的设备接入物联网平台的认证方式。

secret：使用设备密钥进行设备身份认证。

id2：使用物联网设备身份认证ID²。

x509：使用设备X.509证书进行设备身份认证

DataFormat.description_en:
The data communication protocol type between devices and the cloud. This parameter is specific to products that use Thing Specification Language models (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior). Valid values:

0: pass-through mode. A custom serial data format is used. In this mode, devices can report raw data (such as binary data streams). IoT Platform runs the data parsing script that you configured in the cloud to convert the raw data into Alink JSON standard data format.

1: Alink JSON. The data exchange protocol between devices and the cloud defined by IoT Platform, in JSON format
DataFormat.description_zh:
设备与云端之间的数据通信协议类型。该参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）的特有参数。
取值：

0：透传模式。使用自定义的串口数据格式。该模式下，设备可以上报原始数据（如二进制数据流）。阿里云物联网平台会运行您配置在云端的数据解析脚本，将原始数据转换成Alink JSON标准数据格式。

1：Alink JSON。阿里云物联网平台定义的设备与云端的数据交换协议，采用JSON格式

DeviceCount.description_en: The number of devices under the product

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the product was created. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 该产品的创建时间。毫秒值时间戳

NodeType.description_en:
The node type of the product. This parameter is specific to products that use Thing Specification Language models (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior). Valid values:

0: device. A device cannot have sub-devices attached. It can connect to IoT Hub directly or as a sub-device of a gateway.

1: gateway. A gateway can have sub-devices attached. It has a sub-device management module, maintains the topology of sub-devices, and can synchronize the topology to the cloud
NodeType.description_zh:
产品的节点类型。该参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）的特有参数。取值：

0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备，可以直连IoT Hub，也可以作为网关的子设备连接IoT Hub。

1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，并且可以将拓扑关系同步到云端

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product. This is the globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform when the product is created
ProductKey.description_zh: 产品的ProductKey。创建产品时，物联网平台为该产品颁发的全局唯一标识

PageSize.description_en: The number of products displayed per page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：表示调用成功。

false：表示调用失败
